limitations: Confidence labels are heuristic, not probabilities.
Unmarked or differently titled sequels and differing author credits can be missed.
No web research or EPUB content analysis performed.
Book IDs are specific to this catalog; duplicate copies are not removed.
Missing-author books are excluded; unmatched books are not asserted to be standalone.
